decisions.reason: The existing message-565 MODIFY already revises the FAQ to state that a referral-free purchase creates six tickets and a commission, both allocated by weighted draw among eligible NFT owners.
The existing MODIFY captures the six-ticket count and weighted draw but omits that the draw selects among eligible NFT owners, the same recipient population established for both allocations.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: After 9 buys, why do only 8 tickets exist? Even a referral-free purchase should create 6 tickets and commission, with both allocated by weighted draw.

value_updates.recipient_selection: weighted draw among eligible NFT owners

decisions.reason: The source changes commission allocation only when a referral is absent; commission paid to a chosen referrer after an accepted referral remains unchanged.
The six-ticket weighted allocation applies to referral-free purchases, not reward entries issued to the chosen referrer when a referral is accepted.
The source changes rewards after a purchase lacks a referral and does not alter which referral identifiers are valid or the prohibition on self-referrals.
The source does not change the NFT token serial used as the referral code or any referral-code display location.
The source establishes no required landing-page copy or layout revision and only changes the no-referral reward allocation behavior.
Allocating six no-referral tickets and a commission by weighted draw does not change the Small Block winner count, prize amount, trigger, pool funding, or weighted-ticket winner eligibility.
Eligible NFT ownership for reward allocation is unrelated to NFT-holder-gated ebook access and does not change its ownership or contract checks.
The source requires a weighted draw but does not specify Chainlink VRF or necessarily change the configured provider or its applicable prize draws.
The no-referral reward allocation decision does not change the badge set, icons, size, or dashboard row layout.
The source changes who receives the no-referral commission and tickets, not the mint price or the configured founder, affiliate, and prize-pool amounts.
